cards.title: Hold the Breach
cards.text: Control at least two locations at round end.

cards.title: Secure the Relay
cards.text: Control the location closest to the battlefield center.

cards.title: Disrupt Communications
cards.text: Control a location in the enemy half.

cards.title: Eliminate the Vanguard
cards.text: Destroy an enemy Fast unit during this round.

cards.title: Break the Defense
cards.text: Destroy an enemy Vehicle, Walker or Creature this round.

cards.title: Recover the Artifact
cards.text: Finish with a squad within four inches of the center.

cards.title: Behind Enemy Lines
cards.text: Finish with two squads in the enemy deployment band.

cards.title: Sabotage the Generator
cards.text: Control more locations than the opponent, including an enemy-half location.

cards.title: Establish a Forward Position
cards.text: Finish with two squads in the enemy half.

cards.title: Defend the Strongpoint
cards.text: Control at least one home-half location and lose no squads this round.

cards.title: Cut the Command Link
cards.text: Destroy an enemy Leader during this round.

cards.title: Hold the Network
cards.text: Control at least three locations at round end.

primaries.title: Secure the Field
primaries.text: 2 points per controlled location, maximum 6 per round.

primaries.title: Convergence
primaries.text: 4 points for the central location, plus 1 per other controlled location (maximum 6).

primaries.title: Network Superiority
primaries.text: 5 points when controlling more locations than the opponent; otherwise 2 for at least one.
